name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its MoE design cuts latency 30-40% while keeping accuracy high, giving us a real 0.5%+ capability bump without extra hardware. The trade-off is higher memory usage per query, but EXCAVA’s 8xA100 node can handle it with headroom to spare.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B’s MoE claim ignores sharding overhead—EXCAVA’s 8xA100 node can’t hide it. DeepSeek-R1-671B’s dense architecture caps us at 6x speedup, but its "safer bet" label is a trap. Run both on EXCAVA’s real workload; if R1-671B’s throughput beats Qwen3’s latency-adjusted accuracy by 0.5%, it wins.
